title: Little Willie and the unrecorded New Orleans pianists
summary: Little Willie and Red held jam sessions; these men played everything with a strong left hand like a whole band, and none got to record. Terry Wilson took some of their style.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
